editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out the person you thought you would marry has not only dumped you but is already dating someone new. That is exactly where Peter and Emma find themselves. They are both heartbroken and desperate, which leads them to form a weird alliance. Instead of moving on, they decide to team up and coach each other on how to win their exes back. It is a lighthearted, funny ride that feels like a modern take on the classic romantic comedy. You will find yourself rooting for them even when their plan is totally crazy.

The chemistry between the leads is great, and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling too slow. While some of the jokes are a bit predictable, the charm of the characters makes up for it. If you are looking for something easy to watch on a Friday night, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: After spending the whole movie trying to get their old partners back, Peter and Emma realize they have actually fallen for each other. They stop chasing their exes and decide to start a new relationship together. The twist is that the very plan they used to win back their old flames actually helped them find their true match. It ends on a happy note with the two of them finally moving forward in life as a couple.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute rom-coms and stories about second chances.
